flags.title: `README.md` is listed as quoting the S2 row-level headline but is missing
flags.detail: nothing checks the S2 row-level pair against prose until it is rewritten. `needtowrite.md` holds the spec and the un-regenerable content; drop the entry from `PROSE_CLAIMS` if the document is gone for good.

flags.title: the 95% target is missed on the lockbox
flags.detail: rev8 scores **0.9308** at coverage 76.4%. Every development number in §2 is an upper bound, not an estimate.

flags.title: per-subject macro-F1 spread is wide
flags.detail: **0.8553 (rev5) – 0.9687 (rev3)** over 7 subjects. A single unusual subject moves the shipped threshold more than any tuning does.

flags.title: the worst corpus files are a cluster
flags.detail: **12 of 78 files** commit to under 50% of their rows, across 1 variant(s) and 4 session(s); dominant reason `model_split` on 12 of them. They **concentrate on one variant (`fb5ea2c2`) in 4 session(s): 20251230, 20260107, 20260108, 20260109** — that is a session-level cause, not 12 hard recordings. Nobody has looked at one by eye: `python -m stages.s3_physics.inspect_window`.

flags.title: some hardware cannot be served at all
flags.detail: **13 file(s)** refuse with `UnknownVariantError`. Each needs one paired raw+annotated recording to map its sagittal axis; signal-only detection scores below chance.

flags.title: label-audit trials below the line and unadjudicated
flags.detail: rev5/t3 at 0.30; rev5/t2 at 0.20; rev5/t4 at 0.20; rev8/t4 at 0.14 — under the `disagree > 0.5` exclusion line and above everything else. Nothing excludes them and nobody has read them.
